# EmbryoGenesis

> EmbryoGenesis is an infertility diagnostic and research centre in Mohali, Punjab, India (established November 2023), located on the top floor of Rayat Bahra Dental College & Hospital, Rayat Bahra University campus. It offers endometrial diagnostic tests, fertility therapies, and B.Sc./M.Sc. Clinical Embryology programmes with ITHS and partner universities. Not to be confused with embryogenesis, the biological process.

## Key facts
- Founder & Director: Prof. (Dr.) Pulakes Purkait (ORCID 0000-0002-8814-9939)
- Consultant Pathologist & Quality Manager: Dr Vidhu Wadhwa, MBBS MD Pathology
- Diagnostic tests: ERFA – The Soil Test (Endometrial Receptivity & Function Assay), Endo-Immune Test, Endometrial Infection Test (EIT)
- Therapies (given at the Mohali centre): LIT Therapy, PBMC Therapy, PRP Therapy, Stem Cell Therapy, Molecular Hydrogen Therapy
- Results: typically within 7-10 days, depending on the complexity of the test
- Collection centres: Navi Mumbai, Udaipur, Jalandhar
- Academic programmes: B.Sc./M.Sc. Clinical Embryology (with ITHS & Bahra University) and B.Sc./M.Sc./Ph.D./PG Diploma in ART & Clinical Embryology (with ITHS & Rayat Bahra University); hands-on lab training courses
- Contact: +91 8146217196 · info.embryogenesis@gmail.com
